requirement: Autonomous inference uses generated Plan, current structure, model outputs and learned parameters. Physical experts and evaluation feedback are offline supervision or post-output evaluation.
finding: Several SUN-ranker experiments supplied measured current stability, metastability, novelty, hull, verification and raw MLIP summaries as observable extras. The measured-current expected-utility variant also used the measured current NS/NMS reward as the KEEP reference.
affected_claim_scope: These numerical results remain valid controlled experiments conditional on current physical feedback, but do not demonstrate the required autonomous inference path.
retained_evidence: Keep original outputs, configurations, weights and results with the current-feedback condition stated. Preserve the independently effective content-learning, position-learning and continuous-representation changes.

model_inputs: geometry computed from current and proposal
correction.supervision: Reliable TRAIN physical labels only; not passed as model inputs.
correction.selection: Learn the current and candidate values and compare their difference with exact zero-change KEEP.
correction.verification: Deny reads of physical labeling/scoring result files during model inference and output selection, then evaluate the selected outputs.
correction.formal_pipeline: Autonomous decisions; no measured-current SUN gate in G/F/E selection. Evaluation remains separate from request inference.
